metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the Monday ink, Egeon, the fourteen lines, and the March page.

yesterday: The horn is full. Twopence. The ink is browner than March.
You opened Errors as Egeon. The Rose billed The Disguises, and you did not go.
The first fourteen lines are written, for your own mouth. You did not rule them.
The Verona page now reads dignitie. The sheet stops before the two fathers.
